title: After the game, Mike LaFleur gave a run down of the Cardinals' injuries on Saturday night: - P Blake Gillikin suffered his groin injury during warm-ups and will have an MRI on Sunday. Once LaFleur heard about the injury, he didn't ask Gillikin if he thought he could go. He just shut him down for the day. If this was the regular season, LaFleur said, he would've asked Gillikin if he could've played. - LaFleur doesn't think S Dadrion Taylor-Demerson's ribs injury is serious but "I can't answer that right now," he said after the game. - WR Xavier Weaver is dealing with a hamstring. - CB Kei'Trel Clark suffered a hip injury. - S Wydett Williams Jr. and CB Kalen King are both being evaluated for concussions.

title: Crazy NFL preseason story: Dolphins coach Jeff Harley met LB Steve Dix Jr., signed Friday, for first time on Saturday morning. Dix played the entire second half Saturday afternoon. He actually called the D without knowing the plays. Coaches would give him the call, Dix would call it, then coaches would tell him what he was supposed to do. title: Eagles 21, Patriots 24: Stock Up, Stock Down STOCK UP: Backup O-Line: The Eagles might have an entire backup offensive line as good as some starting offensive lines. Markel Bell, Drew Kendall, Willie Lampkin and Jake Majors all had some great snaps vs the Patriots but it was the running game where they especially shined. The unit created some huge holes for Will Shipley (who also helped his stock) to lead the offense down the field for their first touchdown of the preseason. Credit to Chris Kuper for the job he is doing with the young offensive linemen. Ty Robinson: Earlier this week Vic Fangio said that Robinson has gone from being on life support to having life. Now he might have a roster spot. Robinson had two more sacks on Saturday night, giving him three in the two preseason games. Carson Steele: Steele can’t make the roster, can he? He cartainly played on Saturday night like he deserves a roster spot. If the Eagles feel great about him at fullback you have to wonder if he is in uniform on Week 1 from the practice squad. STOCK DOWN: Andy Dalton: Dalton got the start but he struggled for the second preseason game in a row on Saturday night, going 3/10 for 44 yards. McKee was the much better quarterback and it feels like this game might be the one that Dalton behind in the competition. Eli Stowers: It really feels like Stowers needs a big play to get going and just can’t find it. So many skill players made awesome plays on Saturday night and Stowers once again wasn’t one of them. It is feeling less-and-less likely he is active in Week 1. Ambry Thomas: Thomas’ chance of making the roster were slim going into the game but he didn’t help himself by being burned deep for a long touchdown. The Eagles backup cornerbacks didn’t have a great night as Keele Ringo got called for an illegal contact penalty.

title: 49ers practice in the books — with the stands for fans taken down, a sign that the regular season is looming... 🏈Mike Evans was back and his connection with Brock Purdy remains very hard to cover. Purdy loves to stretch the field outside the numbers with Evans, who always seems to separate on such routes. Especially impressive TD on one such out where Purdy delivered a dot across the hash 🏈No De'Zhaun Stribling or Deommodore Lenoir, both of whom are day-to-day with what seem to be minor shoulder issues 🏈Kaelon Black continues to look like a fixture. Purdy clearly trusts him in the check-down game, which is huge. Black had a TD run in red zone over the left side (good block from Carver Willis) and positioned himself perfectly for a side-arm Purdy outlet today... very nuanced but very important detail. 🏈Black has been similarly detailed in pass protection. He credits his responsibilities at national power Indiana 🏈Speaking of RB, Jordan James was back from his broken rib today — and the 49ers clearly have way more juice at the position than just a few days ago 🏈Nice rainbow delivery from Mac Jones to Deebo Samuel on a deeper out 🏈Rookie TE Khalil Dinkins is back after spending the offseason with the 49ers. Jake Tonges had a big day for the TEs, catching a number of passes downfield 🏈It's been about 4 weeks since Vederian Lowe suffered his high ankle sprain. 4-6 weeks is the typical recovery timeline. Will we see the 49ers' top swing tackle soon? 🏈Urgency for Lowe's return heightened with Austen Pleasants (knee) not practicing. Renardo Green (hamstring), Nick Martin (hamstring), and Robert Jones (calf) all also out today 🏈Dominick Puni and CJ West also back today — key pieces for the interior. Worth noting that Raheem Morris noted that he believes Alfred Collins "is getting his legs under him" following shoulder surgery — feels that the 49ers believe better pad level and performance vs the run is around the corner for Collins 🏈Nice connection from Adrian Martinez to WR Trenton Irwin on a rollout and throw to the sideline. Martinez also found Deebo Samuel for a TD in red-zone work 🏈Purdy sailed a throw too high for Jordan Watkins, but Ji'Ayir Brown was unable to hold onto the INT 🏈Jacob Cowing made a couple catches today outside the numbers including one where he had to climb the ladder with much taller CB Ephesians Prysock covering him. I thought today marked the most presence Cowing has shown on routes to the boundary which is key for the 5-9 target's push to contribute as a receiver 🏈Morris on the defense's game in LA: "It was a great bounce-back performance" from Tuesday's practice. Said the 49ers needed that adversity to show they right the ship through adversity 🏈49ers back at at practice tomorrow morning and then again on Tuesday. The preseason ends on Thursday in Las Vegas — and takeoff to Australia is only about 1.5 weeks away. It's getting real!
summary:
49ers practice in the books — with the stands for fans taken down, a sign that the regular season is looming...

🏈Mike Evans was back and his connection with Brock Purdy remains very hard to cover. Purdy loves to stretch the field outside the numbers with Evans, who always seems to separate on such routes. Especially impressive TD on one such out where Purdy delivered a dot across the hash
🏈No De'Zhaun Stribling or Deommodore Lenoir, both of whom are day-to-day with what seem to be minor shoulder issues
🏈Kaelon Black continues to look like a fixture. Purdy clearly trusts him in the check-down game, which is huge. Black had a TD run in red zone over the left side (good block from Carver Willis) and positioned himself perfectly for a side-arm Purdy outlet today... very nuanced but very important detail.
🏈Black has been similarly detailed in pass protection. He credits his responsibilities at national power Indiana
🏈Speaking of RB, Jordan James was back from his broken rib today — and the 49ers clearly have way more juice at the position than just a few days ago 
🏈Nice rainbow delivery from Mac Jones to Deebo Samuel on a deeper out
🏈Rookie TE Khalil Dinkins is back after spending the offseason with the 49ers. Jake Tonges had a big day for the TEs, catching a number of passes downfield 
🏈It's been about 4 weeks since Vederian Lowe suffered his high ankle sprain. 4-6 weeks is the typical recovery timeline. Will we see the 49ers' top swing tackle soon?
🏈Urgency for Lowe's return heightened with Austen Pleasants (knee) not practicing. Renardo Green (hamstring), Nick Martin (hamstring), and Robert Jones (calf) all also out today 
🏈Dominick Puni and CJ West also back today — key pieces for the interior. Worth noting that Raheem Morris noted that he believes Alfred Collins "is getting his legs under him" following shoulder surgery — feels that the 49ers believe better pad level and performance vs the run is around the corner for Collins
🏈Nice connection from Adrian Martinez to WR Trenton Irwin on a rollout and throw to the sideline. Martinez also found Deebo Samuel for a TD in red-zone work 
🏈Purdy sailed a throw too high for Jordan Watkins, but Ji'Ayir Brown was unable to hold onto the INT
🏈Jacob Cowing made a couple catches today outside the numbers including one where he had to climb the ladder with much taller CB Ephesians Prysock covering him. I thought today marked the most presence Cowing has shown on routes to the boundary which is key for the 5-9 target's push to contribute as a receiver
🏈Morris on the defense's game in LA: "It was a great bounce-back performance" from Tuesday's practice. Said the 49ers needed that adversity to show they right the ship through adversity
🏈49ers back at at practice tomorrow morning and then again on Tuesday. The preseason ends on Thursday in Las Vegas — and takeoff to Australia is only about 1.5 weeks away.

It's getting real!

So yeah, I mean, I'm gonna keep whatever I feel for me and my family internally on how I feel about that. Last time I played on this field, I tore my Achilles, and that same fan base they cheered when I got hurt. So does that...have to do with, what does that have to do with anything about performance, when a person gets hurt, especially for your own city, and they cheer? I don't know. You know, it's a mental battle every day. You know, I feel like...I get more love on road games than I do home games. So, if it is my spot and he does make me the (starter), maybe it's 17 away games then. I don't know. I don't know."
